title: In Pictures: Security in the age of shadow AI Security Centric roundtable
headline: Executive roundtable discusses shadow AI and data governance
summary: An iTnews executive roundtable explored the challenges of managing shadow AI within organisations. Delegates discussed strategies for strengthening data governance and establishing secure foundations for AI adoption while meeting regulatory expectations.
why_it_matters: Australian organisations must balance the need for business velocity with the requirement to manage shadow AI risks and comply with an evolving regulatory landscape.

quotes.text: Delegates discussed how to identify and manage shadow AI, strengthen data governance, and build secure foundations for AI adoption while maintaining business velocity and meeting evolving regulatory expectations.
build secure foundations for AI adoption while maintaining business velocity and meeting evolving regulatory expectations.

classification.significance_reason: The item reports on industry discussions regarding AI governance challenges rather than a formal policy or regulatory change.
